title: Interaction, Simple Conflict, Hazards, Pickups & Objective Primitives
objective: Define original reusable MAL-local interaction, simple-conflict, hazard, pickup-reference and objective primitives over frozen MAL-01..03 semantics without creating parallel Combat, Inventory, Action/Event, Character, World/Scene, Project, progression or Permission truth.

rules: MAL-04 consumes frozen MAL-02 semantic inputs and deterministic logical ticks plus MAL-03 local traversal context; raw device identity, wall-clock time, frame timing and network latency never become interaction truth.

Interaction primitives operate on MAL-local target references and authorized owner-domain references only. Unknown, hidden or unauthorized target, conflict, hazard, pickup or objective state remains unresolved and is never inferred as available, safe, defeated, collected or complete.

Simple conflict is a bounded MAL-local contest projection only. It may track local advantage, setback and resolution state but never creates or mutates canonical Combat initiative, hit points, damage, conditions, wounds, Character position, World state or encounter truth.

Hazards may project authorized hazard references and MAL-local avoided/triggered progress only. Triggering a hazard never applies damage, conditions, inventory loss, Character mutation or World/Scene mutation.

Pickup primitives may reference authorized canonical Inventory/Asset records. collected-local-reference means only that a MAL-local interaction step observed completion; MAL-04 never creates, grants, transfers, equips, consumes, destroys or rewards an item.
Objective primitives track MAL-local interaction progress only. satisfied-local or failed-local never commits Event, Project, campaign, progression, reward, reputation or advancement truth.
Resolution may emit deterministic owner-reference result identifiers for later owning integrations, but MAL-04 never commits owner-domain outcomes.
Pause/retry and accessibility-equivalent control behavior remain governed by frozen MAL-02 semantics; traversal positioning remains governed by MAL-03.
AI may propose interaction definitions but cannot invent hidden state, resolve owner truth, apply damage, grant inventory, complete canonical objectives or commit outcomes.
forbidden: copied proprietary game/ROM interaction logic, combat tables, hazard scripts, loot tables, objective scripts or level layouts
Inventory item creation, ownership transfer, equipment, consumption, destruction, loot or reward mutation
Event, Project, campaign, progression, reputation, advancement or reward commit
hidden-data reveal or unauthorized availability inference

invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-04 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
next_action: Validate and merge the bounded MAL-04 governed-start AIOC branch, then create application branch integration/mal-04-interaction-conflict-hazards-pickups-objectives from exact main 87d08c663606e0d0e1afc9955b069891367b8f83, establish genuine matching acceptance RED before production mutation, and continue through exact-head validation, merge, MAL-04 closeout and MAL-05 successor selection without returning control unless a genuine blocker survives.
